rules.name: Disallow MD5 Hash Algorithm
rules.description: MD5 is cryptographically broken due to practical collision attacks and must not be used for security purposes.

rules.name: Disallow SHA-1 for Digital Signatures
rules.description: SHA-1 has proven collision attacks (SHAttered, Shambles) and is disallowed by NIST SP 800-131A for digital signatures.
rules.remediation: Upgrade signature hash algorithm to SHA-256 or SHA-384.

rules.name: Minimum RSA Key Size 2048-bit
rules.description: RSA key sizes below 2048 bits provide less than 112 bits of classical security and are immediately exploitable.
rules.remediation: Immediately upgrade to RSA-3072/4096 or migrate to NIST FIPS 204 ML-DSA.

rules.name: Disallow Legacy 3DES and DES Ciphers
rules.description: 3DES and DES are vulnerable to Sweet32 collision attacks on 64-bit blocks and are deprecated by NIST SP 800-131A.

rules.name: Mandatory Post-Quantum Transition Plan for Mosca Deficit
rules.description: Assets where data lifetime (X) plus migration duration (Y) exceeds quantum horizon (Z) pose an immediate Harvest Now, Decrypt Later (HNDL) exposure.
rules.remediation: Formulate migration plan to FIPS 203 ML-KEM or FIPS 204 ML-DSA and enable PQ/T hybrid mode.

rules.name: Enforce TLS 1.2+ Protocol Baseline
rules.description: Protocols prior to TLS 1.2 (SSL 3.0, TLS 1.0, TLS 1.1) lack forward secrecy and contain known cipher vulnerabilities.
rules.remediation: Configure TLS 1.3 with support for RFC 10024 hybrid key exchange (e.g. X25519MLKEM768).

rules.name: Expiring Certificate Proactive Renewal
rules.description: Certificates expiring within 30 days must be renewed proactively to prevent enterprise service outage.
rules.remediation: Renew certificate using modernized public key and signature parameters.
